name: GO2 Tech
description: Philadelphia managed IT and cybersecurity. Nexus bundle, firewall, backup, and access control. Twenty-plus years with area businesses. Contact the team on the official site.

hero.headline: Philadelphia's managed IT and security provider
hero.sub: GO2 Tech runs managed IT and cybersecurity for Greater Philadelphia businesses. Twenty-plus years on the work. Nexus is the bundle: firewall, backup, access control.

offerings.heading: Nexus, then the <mark>rest of the stack.</mark>
items: The Nexus managed IT security bundle is the starting point for shops that don't want a pile of vendors.
Firewall and backup sit in the same conversation, so a breach and a failed drive aren't two tickets.
Access control for the door and the network, handled by the same Philadelphia team.
Nexus bundle, firewall, backup, access control

story.heading: Managed IT that still lives in Philadelphia
paragraphs: GO2 Tech has spent twenty-plus years on managed IT and security for Greater Philadelphia businesses. The pitch isn't a founding plaque. It's a stack that stays on one contract.
Nexus is the named bundle. Firewall, backup, and access control ride with it. You contact the team on the official site when you want the assessment.

experience.heading: How the work is supposed to feel.
items: You ask for the security assessment. They tell you what's actually open.
Nexus covers the daily stack so you aren't stitching five invoices.
The same people who sold the bundle still answer when something breaks.

feature.heading: Nexus is the managed IT security bundle
feature.text: Firewall, backup, access control. Named as one package so the business isn't left assembling a security stack from leftover vendors.

contact.heading: Request the <mark>assessment.</mark>
contact.sub: Philadelphia and the surrounding business map. Use the official site to reach the team. No public phone was listed on the harvest.
